findings.passage: It’s blowing my mind that three people who were sworn in onto this council, and they raised their hand and swore to protect and defend our Constitution walked out on this item. That’s very telling,
findings.note: As Huntington Beach mayor, quoted by a news outlet (California Insider) criticizing three councilors who walked out before the council's 4-0 vote on a resolution calling the city a 'First and Second Amendment friendly city'. Her remarks are about the walkout; the story does not say she sponsored the resolution or how she voted.

findings.motion: Huntington Beach City Council resolution affirming the city as a First and Second Amendment friendly city, passed 4-0 (June 4, 2024); her individual vote is not stated in the story
findings.note: News report of a city council resolution passed 4-0 while three councilors walked out. She was mayor at the time; the story does not list her vote or sponsor. Council minutes were not reviewed.
